title: YouTube Bans Popular ASMR Artists, Accusing Them of Making 'Sexually Gratifying' Content
excerpt: YouTube told ASMR artists including Bunnii, Slight Sounds, Rose, and others that their content broke the platform's sex and nudity policy. Creators say these bans are unfair and potentially life-altering.
